svg.title: FIG-31 F4 source ownership and interface boundaries Each edge distinguishes build inputs from calls; no qualification
svg.desc: io/: public types, requests and borrow contracts; F4 drivers/<domain>/ Bindings, instance.h and controller C; F4 system/ Startup, clocks, memory, power and shared lifecycle; F4 drivers/ip/ and private/ Shared algorithms, cross-domain contracts and fragments; F4 sdk/ Official source selection and hal_config; vendors/st/: F4 HAL / Device Inventory retained; selected inputs consumed; tests/support/native/ Explicit test scope, not a production SoC; components/devices/: ILI9341 / XPT2046 / W25; package.json, facts/ and adjacent bindings Board JSON and external TOML; tools/configure/: generic DataProvider Domain policies, named IR, bounded static assembly; Generated nexus_bindings.c Static instances, faces and fixed lifecycle connections; Runtime: public narrow-port access; Runtime: ops(context); Build: select private source; Build: private include / link; Build: private include / link; Build: selected official sources only; Tests: execute real hardware algorithm C; Build: one input snapshot; Build: emit bounded static connections; Build: private types, fixed C calls and links; Build: fixed lifecycle connections
